"""Subscribe to one VelaGuard device on the dashboard broker. Do not print the password."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import socket
import struct
import sys
import time


HOST = "8.148.67.174"
PORT = 1883
USER = "velaguard"
PASS = "2f4505862d80e2ccb8fd5ff0739e172f"
DEVICE = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "vg-09001a800451383430303835"
WAIT_S = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 40


def enc_len(n: int) -> bytes:
    out = bytearray()
    while True:
        b = n % 128
        n //= 128
        if n:
            b |= 0x80
        out.append(b)
        if not n:
            return bytes(out)


def enc_str(s: str) -> bytes:
    b = s.encode("utf-8")
    return struct.pack("!H", len(b)) + b


def pkt(typ: int, payload: bytes, flags: int = 0) -> bytes:
    return bytes([typ | flags]) + enc_len(len(payload)) + payload


def read_pkt(sock: socket.socket) -> tuple[int, int, bytes]:
    hdr = sock.recv(1)
    if not hdr:
        raise ConnectionError("eof")
    typ_flags = hdr[0]
    mul = 1
    rem = 0
    while True:
        b = sock.recv(1)
        if not b:
            raise ConnectionError("eof rem")
        rem += (b[0] & 0x7F) * mul
        if (b[0] & 0x80) == 0:
            break
        mul *= 128
    body = b""
    while len(body) < rem:
        chunk = sock.recv(rem - len(body))
        if not chunk:
            raise ConnectionError("eof body")
        body += chunk
    return typ_flags >> 4, typ_flags & 0x0F, body


def parse_publish(flags: int, body: bytes) -> tuple[str, bytes]:
    tlen = struct.unpack("!H", body[:2])[0]
    topic = body[2 : 2 + tlen].decode("utf-8", "replace")
    off = 2 + tlen
    qos = (flags >> 1) & 0x03
    if qos:
        off += 2
    return topic, body[off:]


def main() -> int:
    cid = f"vg-sub-accept-{int(time.time()) % 100000}"
    flags = 0xC2  # user + pass + clean
    payload = enc_str(cid) + enc_str(USER) + enc_str(PASS)
    var = enc_str("MQTT") + bytes([4, flags]) + struct.pack("!H", 60) + payload
    sock = socket.create_connection((HOST, PORT), timeout=15)
    sock.settimeout(5)
    sock.sendall(pkt(0x10, var))
    ptype, _, body = read_pkt(sock)
    if ptype != 2 or body[-1] != 0:
        print(f"CONNACK fail type={ptype} rc={body[-1] if body else '?'}")
        return 1
    print("CONNACK ok")

    filter_topic = f"vg/{DEVICE}/#"
    sub = struct.pack("!H", 1) + enc_str(filter_topic) + bytes([0])
    sock.sendall(pkt(0x82, sub))
    ptype, _, _ = read_pkt(sock)
    if ptype != 9:
        print(f"SUBACK missing type={ptype}")
        return 1
    print(f"SUBACK ok filter={filter_topic}")

    seen: dict[str, str] = {}
    deadline = time.time() + WAIT_S
    while time.time() < deadline:
        try:
            ptype, flags, body = read_pkt(sock)
        except socket.timeout:
            continue
        except ConnectionError:
            print("socket closed")
            break
        if ptype == 3:

## 背景

2026-09-14 的板端看门狗记录里，`vg_net_thread` 在 `nxsem_clockwait` 中走过被清空的 watchdog 活动链表，随后在 `wd_start_abstick [NULL,#16]` 处 hard fault，`BFAR=0x10`。

## 说明
